notes: Version 2.15 registers the O31 version 2.0 withdrawal. The programme no longer presents individual colour-profile co-admissibility, the q congruent 1 modulo 3 triplet criterion, the metaplectic colour step, the Delta(27) proposition, the rank-eight test, SU(3) uniqueness, or any derivation of the Standard Model gauge group as established. The O31 entry records the SO(3), diagonal-torus and {1,2,q-3} counterexamples. O32 numerical values remain measurements but no longer support a group identification. Q6a, Q12-Q14 and the synthesis descriptions are retyped accordingly: Yang-Mills dynamics remains conditional on a supplied compact gauge group, while the colour factor and complete gauge group are open.
